item.title: 🔵 Researchers Detail DifyTap Flaws in Dify That Could Expose AI Chats Across Tenants
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of four vulnerabilities in Dify, an open-source agentic workflow platform with more than 146,000 GitHub stars, that could allow attackers to stealthily read artificial intelligence (AI) conversions from other customers' applications without requiring authentication. The vulnerabilities have been collectively codenamed DifyTap by Zafran Security.

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 1h ago

item.title: 🔵 Google Sets Sept. 30 Deadline for Android Developer Verification in Four Countries
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Google has set September 30, 2026, as the day it begins enforcing Android developer verification in the first four countries, and the major device-maker app stores are in from the start.
